Summary: The Nobel Prize in Physics 2024 was awarded to John J. Hopfield and Geoffrey E. Hinton "for foundational discoveries and inventions that enable machine learning with artificial neural networks." The award recognizes their seminal work in developing foundational methods that form the basis for today’s machine learning technologies and artificial neural networks. They used principles from physics to train artificial neural networks capable of recognizing patterns and learning from data, contributing greatly to the current expansion and explosion in machine learning approaches and artificial intelligence (AI) methods.

Summary: The sources indicate that the Nobel Prize in Physics 2024 was awarded to John Hopfield and Geoffrey Hinton "for foundational discoveries and inventions that enable machine learning with artificial neural networks." observations.content:
Summary: The Nobel Prize in Physics for 2020 was awarded to Roger Penrose, Reinhard Genzel, and Andrea Ghez for their contributions to the understanding of black holes. Roger Penrose received half the prize for his 1965 paper showing that black hole formation is a robust prediction of the general theory of relativity. Reinhard Genzel and Andrea Ghez shared the other half for their independent observations of stars orbiting the supermassive black hole at the center of the Milky Way. The Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences highlighted that their discoveries advanced our understanding of black holes, one of the most exotic phenomena in the universe.
